narr: Clusters of slow moving thunderstorms produced heavy rainfall in a short period of time, leading to areas of flash flooding in Washington county and on St George Island. Over 4 inches of rain was measured in Washington county and almost 7 inches of rain was measured on St George Island.
ev: The intersection of Pioneer Road and Gainer Road was flooded.

Several roads were reported underwater across St George Island with pictures on social media of flooding as well. An Ambient weather station on 7th St W on St George Island measured 6.94 inches of rain in about 5 hours.
lsr: Flooding reported along Pioneer Road at Gainer Rd. Time estimated by radar.
